Ash: safe electrical learning · expanded view

Ash likes following diagrams, building low-voltage circuits and finding a loose connection. Paid apprenticeship learning is attractive, though college remains possible. Ash wants a practical career with teamwork, a dependable car and growing savings. No answer implies that unsupervised mains wiring is appropriate for a student.

Narrative model, with its answers frozen before the first run. Optional questions omitted by the shorter route are marked. These are synthetic checks, not observations of students.

Authored model & first-run review

Completed a supervised low-voltage classroom kit and helped measure parts for a household project. Electrical installation is new.

Interest and a kit are not proof of electrical aptitude, safety training, licensure or readiness for unsupervised work.
